meta.siteDescription: AI/ML Engineer and Full-Stack Developer. Portfolio of Marshall Rasendria Mahendra, styled as a living Word document.

paragraphs: I train machine learning models and then build the full-stack platforms that put them in front of real people. Currently an Information Systems undergraduate at Telkom University, currently interning as an AI Engineer, and permanently curious.

In the past 6 months I shipped 6+ end-to-end products, reached the finalist stage in 3 national hackathons, and collected 5 professional certifications from Google, IBM, Microsoft, and HackerRank. I like my evaluation leakage-free, my APIs documented, and my coffee unsupervised.
This whole site is one big document. Go ahead, switch to Editing mode and mess with it. It resets when you refresh, just like my sleep schedule.

experience.summary: Delivering AI/ML solutions for an enterprise client as part of the outsourced engineering team.

Translating business requirements into technical solutions while following production standards for reproducibility and code quality.
Hands-on with Google Cloud Platform, using BigQuery for large-scale data querying and processing.

experience.summary: Medical imaging research on mammography classification, from literature review to a published IEEE paper.
points: Conducted a systematic literature review across IEEE, Scopus, and Google Scholar, exposing that many 98 to 99 percent accuracy claims come from patient-level data leakage.
Built leakage-free PyTorch pipelines on CBIS-DDSM and trained 6 architectures, from EfficientNet-B3 and ConvNeXt to a CBAM hybrid-fusion network and Mammo-CLIP, across 12+ controlled experiments.
Raised AUC by about 6 points with clinical-metadata fusion (0.80 to 0.86) and first-authored a 6-page IEEE conference paper.

faq.q: Why does your portfolio look like Microsoft Word?
faq.a: Because every portfolio looks the same, and nobody expects a resume that is literally a document you can poke at. Also, I spend half my life in documents anyway.

faq.q: Can I really edit this page?
faq.a: Yes. Switch to Editing mode at the top right, select some text, and go wild with the toolbar. Refresh the page and everything is back to normal. No commitment issues here.

faq.q: AI/ML or full-stack, which one are you really?
faq.a: Both, and that is the point. I train the model, then I build the product around it. A model without a product is a very expensive CSV file.

faq.q: What are you looking for right now?
faq.a: Interesting problems, good teams, and opportunities in AI/ML engineering or full-stack roles. If you have one of those, the comment section and my inbox are open.

faq.q: What is the most honest thing on this site?
faq.a: The research numbers. I spent a whole internship proving that most 99 percent accuracy claims in mammography papers come from data leakage. My 0.86 AUC is boring and real, and I am proud of it.

typing.intro: Type the sentence as fast and as accurately as you can. Scores go straight to the public leaderboard, so no pressure.
sentences: I train machine learning models and then build the platforms that bring them to life.
Leakage free evaluation beats a suspiciously perfect accuracy score every single time.
Ship fast, measure honestly, and never trust a model you cannot explain.
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog while training a neural network.
Good engineers write code that works, great engineers write code that others understand.
Data leakage is the art of accidentally cheating on your own exam.
Marshall builds full stack platforms powered by carefully evaluated models.
Ketik kalimat ini secepat mungkin tanpa typo, kalau bisa sambil senyum.
